Welcome to DATA 608, Knowledge and Visual Analytics.

Click this post now to get started!

Here are the first steps:

* Read the [syllabus](../course/syllabus.qmd).
* Go through the course overview materials, and complete the [week 1 readings](../modules/module1.qmd).
* [Make sure you have a good visualization toolkit set up](../course/software.qmd)
* Introduce yourself on the course discussion forum on Brightspace.
* Join the course Slack workspace (invite link to be posted).
* Attend the first meetup on Monday August 31 at 8:00PM Eastern at the [Zoom link on the schedule page](../course/schedule.qmd).

I'm looking forward to working with all of you this semester!
